missing_claims.claim: Exact 2014 RT2 landing on the ligated adapter
missing_claims.evidence: Original Methods lines 370-375 say the second RT primer complements the ligated adapter, but Table S7 prints TCTAGCCTTCTCGCAGCACATC. The reverse complement of the printed adapter constant AGATCGGAAGAGCGTCGTGTAG is CTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATCT, the later 2.0 RT2. The 2014 site cannot be assigned from the printed sequences.

conclusion: Two independent readers checked the 2014 main article, primer tables and coauthor-uploaded full Methods. The original source resolves reaction order and most conditions. The 2014 RT2 landing conflicts with its printed adapter/primer relationship, and the separate PMC figure PDF remains gated; no missing claim is accepted.
